blocks.arabic_text: الْقُرْآنِ وَذُرْوَتُهُ، نَزَلَ مَعَ كُلِّ آيَةٍ مِنْهَا ثَمَانُوْنَ مَلَكًا، وَاسْتُخْرِجَتْ (اَللهُ لَا اِلهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ۞) مِنْ تَحْتِ الْعَرْشِ، فَوُصِلَتْ بِسُوْرَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ، وَ»يس» قَلْبُ الْقُرْآنِ لَا يَقْرَأُهَا رَجُلٌ يُرِيْدُ اللهَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَي وَالدَّارَ اْلآخِرَةَ اِلَّا غُفِرَ لَهُ وَاقْرَؤُوْهَا عَلي مَوْتَاكُمْ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Surah al-Baqarah is the peak (the highest part) of the noble Qur'an; with each of its ayahs eighty angels descended. Ayat al-Kursi was taken out from beneath the Arsh (it came down from Allah's special treasure (treasury)), and then it was joined to Surah al-Baqarah. Surah Yasin is the heart of the noble Qur'an; whoever recites this surah with conviction, seeking the pleasure of Allah and the Hereafter, will be granted forgiveness. Therefore, recite this surah sitting near one who is at the point of death, so that his soul departs easily,” Hazrat Ma'qil ibn Yasar (RA) reports that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The basic laws and principles of Islam. Because “the laws of the Shari'ah are not described in as much detail in any other chapter of the noble Qur'an as they are described in Surah al-Baqarah”, Surah al-Baqarah has been called the peak of the noble Qur'an in the hadith.
(Ma'ariful Hadith)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جُنْدُبٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ قَرَأَ يس فِيْ لَيْلَةٍ اِبْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ اللهِ غُفِرَ لَهُ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “If anyone recites Surah Yasin at night seeking the pleasure of Allah, his sins will be forgiven,” Hazrat Jundub (RA) reports that the Prophet ﷺ said.
